title: Peak & Destroy
author: Steve  A.
desc: High intensity with moderate to high volume for max strength and hypertrophy. Days 1-5 use a modified Arnold split with day 6 being a lighter, full body active recovery circuit. Most lifts use 1-2 top sets followed by 1-2 back off sets. Take your top sets to failure and then back off sets to 1 RIR, back off sets should use 85-90% of weight from top sets. For supersets, hit one exercise right after the other, then rest 30-40 seconds between sets. Use a double progression strategy but progress your top sets and back off sets independently of one another. Use weeks 5 & 10 as deload weeks if needed.
